nutrition_composition.source: ICMR - National Institute of Nutrition (NIN) / Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017) & USDA FoodData Central

visual_training_data.methodology: Composite Multi-Dish Thali Generator with photorealistic texture synthesis and spatial dish clustering, augmented with realistic lighting, specular reflection on steel thalis, food overlaps, and rotational variances.
visual_training_data.license: Open Source / MIT Compliant for Evaluation

preprocessing_pipeline: Multi-dish composition onto standard circular thalis (diameter 28cm scale reference)
Color jittering (brightness, contrast, saturation) to simulate varying restaurant/home ambient lighting
Bounding box normalization into standard YOLO format [class_id, x_center, y_center, width, height]
